name: Gatekeeper
description_en:
Gatekeeper combines contract lifecycle management with vendor onboarding, third-party risk, spend and supplier performance. Contracts and vendors share a record, so a renewal can be considered together with the supplier’s obligations, risk and actual spend. The product also describes AI agents for intake, review, amendments and renewals.

Its pricing is primarily sized around active third parties and workflows, rather than employee seats. This makes the distinction between a vendor, a contract and an archived relationship important when estimating cost; unlimited contracts do not mean unlimited active vendors.
description_zh:
Gatekeeper 将合同生命周期管理与供应商入驻、第三方风险、支出及绩效结合。合同和供应商共享关联记录，续约时可同时查看义务、风险和实际支出。产品还介绍申请、审阅、补充协议及续约 AI Agent。

定价主要按活跃第三方数量及流程规模，而非员工席位。估算费用时须区分供应商、合同和归档关系：合同不限量不等于活跃供应商不限量。

core_features.name_zh: 统一供应商与合同记录
core_features.explanation_en: Keep obligations, renewals, risk and spend connected to the third-party relationship.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把义务、续约、风险及支出关联至第三方关系。

core_features.explanation_en: Route agreements by value, category or risk and sign with native eSign or DocuSign.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按金额、类别或风险路由合同，使用原生 eSign 或 DocuSign 签署。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing quotas cover pipeline and live third parties, while users and contracts are unlimited.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐额度计算候选及活跃第三方，用户及合同数量不限。

sections.title_en: Review a renewal with supplier context
sections.title_zh: 结合供应商背景审查续约
sections.en: A procurement team could open a supplier renewal and review the agreement, risk evidence, performance and spend together before choosing to renew. The platform documents renewal tracking and supplier scorecards; the pricing matrix places balanced scorecards in Enterprise and Enterprise Plus. Prepare one supplier with two agreements and verify that the records refer to the same controlling relationship rather than two accidental duplicates. This is an evaluation design, not a completed test.
sections.zh: 采购团队可在供应商续约时，一起审查合同、风险证据、绩效和支出，再决定是否续签。平台介绍续约跟踪及供应商评分卡，定价表把平衡评分卡列入 Enterprise 和 Enterprise Plus。可准备一个供应商、两份合同，核对其关联同一业务关系，避免意外重复建档。这是评估设计，未实际测试。

sections.title_en: Set the playbook before delegating review to agents
sections.title_zh: 委托 Agent 审阅前先设置规则
sections.en: The CLM page describes extracting terms and dates, checking agreements against a playbook and surfacing deviations by risk. It also describes automatic reminders and escalation in approval routing. The business still needs approved terms, risk thresholds and accountable decision-makers. Evaluate an unfamiliar clause, conflicting amendment and absent approver before permitting an unattended path. Agent availability does not prove that a legal conclusion is correct.
sections.zh: CLM 页描述提取条款及日期、按规则检查合同、按风险呈现偏差，并在审批中提供自动提醒和升级处理。业务仍需准备批准条款、风险阈值及决策负责人。允许无人值守流程前，可评估陌生条款、冲突补充协议和审批人缺席情形。存在 Agent 功能，不证明法律判断正确。

sections.title_en: Count pipeline and live third parties, not every document
sections.title_zh: 计算候选及活跃第三方，而非每份文档
sections.en: The current Pro card lists up to 250 third parties; Enterprise up to 750; Enterprise Plus 750 or more. The FAQ says pipeline and live relationships count, while archiving unused third parties frees quota and retains their attached data. Contracts, users and eSign senders are described as unlimited. Workflows have separate package counts and MarketIQ Full is usage-based, so a contract count alone cannot estimate the bill.
sections.zh: 当前 Pro 卡片最多 250 个第三方，Enterprise 最多 750 个，Enterprise Plus 为 750 个及以上。FAQ 说明候选和活跃关系计入额度；归档不再使用的第三方可释放额度并保留关联资料。合同、用户及签署发送人标为不限量；流程有独立套餐数量，MarketIQ Full 按用量计，因此不能仅凭合同数估算账单。

sections.title_en: Obtain a quote and implementation statement of work
sections.title_zh: 取得报价和实施工作说明书
sections.en: The official page provides a quotation route without a verified public numeric subscription amount. It says implementation is personalised with professional services and a formal Statement of Work. Request the third-party quota, required custom workflows, integrations and risk-data charges in that scope. Some plan-card highlights differ from detailed rows for SSO and MCP; confirm the order-form entitlement instead of resolving that ambiguity by assumption.
sections.zh: 官网提供询价入口，没有核实到公开订阅金额。页面说明专业服务团队按需求实施，并制定正式工作说明书。应在范围中列明第三方额度、自定义流程、集成和风险数据费用。部分卡片重点与细表对 SSO、MCP 的描述有差异，应以订单确认权益，不能凭假设消除歧义。

sections.title_en: Evaluate a vendor programme rather than a file cabinet
sections.title_zh: 按供应商治理项目而非文件柜评估
sections.en: The service is relevant when finance, procurement and legal need shared vendor context and recurring governance. A team wanting only a private document folder may not need its onboarding and risk model. Begin with a deduplicated supplier register, responsible owners, a contract template and risk policy. The website presents a managed platform; no self-hosted package or open-source licence was verified. Recovery procedures, agent accuracy and data-export completeness were not tested.
sections.zh: 财务、采购和法务需要共享供应商背景并持续治理时，可评估该服务。只想保存私有文件夹的团队，可能不需要其入驻与风险模型。可先准备去重供应商清单、负责人、合同模板及风险政策。官网呈现托管平台，未核实自托管安装包或开源许可，也未测试恢复、Agent 准确率及导出完整性。

research_gaps.en: SSO/MCP card versus matrix ambiguity, payable quote, risk-data usage tariffs, agent controls and disaster-recovery terms remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: SSO／MCP 卡片与细表歧义、应付报价、风险数据用量费率、Agent 控制及灾难恢复条款仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: No hands-on account, contract signing, integration, recovery or performance test was conducted; procurement terms and interface languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际登录账户、签署合同、运行集成、测试恢复或性能；采购条款和界面语言仍未核实。
